decisions.reason: As the firm's flagship platform and strategic focus, its option value remains high and it is unlikely to be dropped while uncertainty about its market persists.
Mobile field data capture is close to the established offer and likely inexpensive to maintain, so the unresolved option value exceeds its carrying cost and supports keeping it.

The search extension is a low-cost component close to existing web map products and still had a version update in 2019, so its option value has not clearly resolved and it is more likely kept than dropped.
